sahneler.metin: Off Oahu, a US submarine shot to the surface under a Japanese training ship.
The ship sank within ten minutes, and nine people were killed.
Sixteen civilian guests were aboard the submarine.
It performed an emergency surfacing manoeuvre for them.
The ship above hadn't been detected.
Four of the dead were high school students.
Japan was angered by the civilians in the control room.
The visitor program came under intense scrutiny.

aciklama:
Ehime Maru sank a Japanese training ship off Oahu. The cause: an emergency ballast blow surfacing performed without spotting the ship above.
